title: Accessibility Audit
prompt: Review a sample page and list corrections for missing alt text, unlabeled controls, broken heading hierarchy, and absent landmarks.
objective: Submit a before/after markup excerpt with your corrections.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: alternative text, labels, landmarks, keyboard access.
hints: Automated checks can identify some problems; keyboard and screen-reader-oriented manual checks are also needed.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.answer:
Accessibility Audit Checklist

Content checks
solution.explanation: One complete example is shown above. Reference approach: Automated checks can identify some problems; keyboard and screen-reader-oriented manual checks are also needed. Required structural evidence: alt=, <label, <main>, <h1>.
solution.expected_result: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: alternative text, labels, landmarks, keyboard access.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
